candidate_state: planned from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.evaluator: material-only release validation; no new evaluator adopted
internal_measurement.results: Workspace tests, release all-feature tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, release-script regression tests, the optional opening-book feature, a native material-only USI smoke, the 95.1224% engine/library line-coverage gate, WebAssembly package generation, native and Node WebAssembly tests, and WebAssembly package metadata validation passed. This release strengthens fail-closed CSA and gate handling, bounds HalfKP training memory, expands behavioral regression coverage, and removes unreachable quiescence-search code. No general playing-strength claim is made.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.69.

known_limitations: No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no general playing-strength claim.
The robustness and coverage changes improve failure detection and evidence integrity but do not by themselves prove playing-strength improvement.
The optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
Hosted CI remains the required browser-level WebAssembly check; local release validation covered package generation, native tests, Node smoke, and metadata.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
